# GO-LIVE-408 — the bounded Maps go-live candidate set

**Derived, never hand-listed.** One predicate over the committed product-readiness artifact,
using the project's OWN substance rule (`docs/app-content-materialize.sql:108`,
`indexable := (pass) AND (_ndp > 0 OR _nfc >= 3)`). No new threshold is introduced.

```
page_exists = yes  AND  coverage_state = 'pass'  AND  (authoritative_dev > 0 OR facilities >= 3)
```

```sh
awk -F, 'NR>1 && $3=="yes" && $4=="pass" && ($6>0 || $12>=3) {print $1}' \
  docs/maps-coverage/completed-shards-product-readiness.csv
```

It reproduces the artifact's own `indexable_after_switch` column exactly (diff empty), which is
the control that the predicate and the artifact agree.
